findings.problem: .claude/.loop-record.lock is not in CWK_GUARD_DENIED (plan step 2, Vigilance) nor guarded; drop_record unlinks inside locked(), so a directory or symlink at the lock path makes --clear raise before the unlink and exit 0.
findings.scenario: Write .claude/.loop-record.lock/x passes every guard; a later blocked stop runs --clear, exit 0, the record survives: --mode still prints auto, record_allow still grants push and PR.
findings.closure: the lock is in CWK_GUARD_DENIED (a Write to it is denied) and drop_record unlinks the record even when the lock cannot be taken; a case puts a directory at the lock path and shows --clear removes the record.

findings.problem: The prompt must name, as never issued in auto, every shell ask the hook keeps (Vigilance, plan-critic Q13/Q14); it names only five broad kinds.
findings.scenario: In auto an agent runs rm -r dist (GUARD_ASK_R) or vitest -u (GUARD_ASK_S): the hook asks, nobody answers, the run stalls instead of a blocked stop.
findings.closure: orchestrate.md names each remaining ask (snapshot update, recursive delete, secret read, unparsable command, whole-folder formatter, source write seen, the other GUARD_ASK kinds, a failed guard) as never issued in auto, and an AMC needle pins them.

findings.problem: auto_mode / cwk_auto_mode accept a record when HEAD is its base, with no slug check: an auto pass abandoned in the main tree leaves the base in auto for the next moi pass.
findings.scenario: Auto pass a on audit/slim abandoned without --clear; pass b framed Validation: moi on audit/slim: --mode prints auto, interface and plan gates go to arbiters, ledgered writes pass with no ask, the Plan gate that would replace the record is never asked.
findings.closure: an auto record on the base branch no longer puts the tree in auto (auto requires HEAD on the record's branch; orchestrate switches to feat/<slug> at the contract go); a case shows a stale auto record read from base prints moi and cwk_auto_mode exits 1.

findings.problem: ledger_entry accepts a non-canonical path (./, absolute) and the first-verdict-final dedupe compares raw strings; consumers match the canonical tree-relative path.
findings.scenario: refuse ledgered for ./src/a/x.utils.test.ts U2; a relaunch answers unfreeze for src/a/x.utils.test.ts: recorded, .tdd-unfrozen line allowed, the freeze lets the edit in: the final refuse is overturned.
findings.closure: ledger_entry records nothing for an absolute path or one with ./, ../ or // segments; a case shows a ./-prefixed refuse block records nothing.

findings.problem: KD27 greps agent-reference; kit-doctor emits agent-refs, so that third of KD27 can never fail.
findings.scenario: kit-doctor reports DIVERGENCE agent-refs naming arbiter on the kit source: KD27 stays green.

findings.problem: G22.004 never asserts the block lists the reverted row from the ledger and has no allow case; its deny needle is shared by both deny reasons.
findings.scenario: guarded_block crashes on a ledger row absent from the diff: the hook denies 'cannot compute', G22.004 stays green, no auto pass with a reverted edit can open its PR.
findings.closure: G22.004 asserts --guarded-block prints the reverted row's ledger line and a body carrying that block is allowed.

findings.problem: No case for a deleted test file (status D) in Guarded files touched (Vigilance).
findings.scenario: (M, D) narrowed to (M,): git rm of a frozen test gives block '- none', PR allowed, suites green.
findings.closure: a G22 case deletes the test file and expects the GUARD FAILURE U2 line and the D (diff) line.

findings.problem: The Python freeze's auto fallbacks-off branch has no case (AM47 is TypeScript only).
findings.scenario: the if-auto branch reverted: a whole-file line unfreezes B2 in auto with no verdict; suites green.
findings.closure: an AM47-py case: auto rec, no verdict, listed or whole-file line → deny; moi → pass.

findings.problem: AMC12 dropped the plan's hash-mismatch needle.
findings.scenario: the 'does not hash to its verdict' clause deleted from tests.md: AMC12 green.
findings.closure: AMC12 also checks 'does not hash to its verdict'.

findings.problem: Decided without you precedes Contract contradiction; the spec puts the contradiction first; Decided without you is transcribed by the model, unchecked by a hook.
findings.scenario: PR reader sees decisions before the contradiction.

findings.problem: cwk_auto_mode ignores barrier; the no-barrier stop is prompt-only.
findings.scenario: record with barrier false still runs auto hooks.

findings.problem: Shell ledger rows are written before later plain asks; flag-w guarded path denied instead of ledgered; --guarded-block silent on fetch failure; leftover local hashlib imports; docstring lacks --guarded-block.
findings.scenario: a command that asks after its row leaves a row for a write that never ran.

findings.problem: name-status without -z misses quoted non-ASCII paths; block computed from local HEAD; block hideable in an HTML comment; Contract re-ask wipes ledgers; hook-lib load check lacks cwk_auto_*; fetch lacks the push path's env hardening.
findings.scenario: src/é.test.ts change neither listed nor checked.

findings.problem: Weak spots: AM35 moi no-row, AM16 types only, AM39 fallback mode, AM26 subset, AM33 2 of 6, AM44 small window, AM4 base path, AMC5.3 tools line absent passes, AMC6.2 -le.
findings.scenario: a regression in those corners stays green.
